name: Convert quality control (qc) data from eddy to regressors datatype
summary: Converts eddy quality-control outputs (motion parameters and RMS movement) into a regressors TSV for use as nuisance variables in statistical analyses; a conversion utility.
description: Reads the eddy_parameters, eddy_movement_rms and eddy_restricted_movement_rms files from an eddy output directory and writes regressors.tsv with translation, rotation, eddy-current terms and framewise displacement columns. Use it after an App that runs FSL eddy and keeps its QC files.

inputs.requirements: Must contain files matching eddy_parameters, eddy_movement_rms and eddy_restricted_movement_rms.

outputs.description: regressors.tsv with per-volume translation, rotation, eddy-current and framewise displacement columns.
